description.zh: 安全访问控制策略的唯一标识ID。
description.en: The unique ID of the access control policy.

description.zh:
访问控制策略的流量方向。

取值：

- **out**：内对外流量。
description.en:
The traffic direction of the access control policy.

Valid values:

- **out**: outbound traffic.

description.zh:
接收消息的语言类型。取值：
- **zh**（默认）：中文
- **en**：英文
description.en:
The language of the content within the response. Valid values:
- **zh** (default): Chinese
- **en**: English

description.zh:
为NAT防火墙IPv4访问控制策略设置一个新的优先级。
优先级使用数字表示，输入数字1表示优先级最高，数字越大优先级越低。

> 新的优先级数字不能超出您已创建的NAT防火墙IPv4策略优先级的范围，否则会导致调用该接口时出错。

建议您在调用该接口前，先调用DescribeNatFirewallPolicyPriorUsed查询NAT防火墙指定流量方向的IPv4策略优先级范围。
description.en:
The policy priority for the NAT firewall IPv4 access control policy. A value of 1 indicates the highest priority. A larger value indicates a lower priority.

> The policy priority value must be within the range of existing NAT firewall IPv4 policy priorities. Otherwise, an error occurs when you call this operation.

Before you call this operation, call DescribeNatFirewallPolicyPriorUsed to query the priority range of IPv4 policies for the specified traffic direction of the NAT firewall.

title.zh: 修改NAT防火墙访问控制策略的优先级
title.en: Modify the priority of a NAT firewall access control policy

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudfw modify-nat-firewall-control-policy-position --lang zh --nat-gateway-id ngw-xxxxxx --direction out --new-order 5 --acl-uuid 66461eea-e659-4225-84c9-00000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudfw ModifyNatFirewallControlPolicyPosition --region cn-hangzhou --Lang zh --AclUuid '66461eea-e659-4225-84c9-00000' --NatGatewayId 'ngw-xxxxxx' --Direction out --NewOrder 5
